subject: Reorder category tabs
body: Where can I change the order of the category tabs on our directory page?
expectedFacts: Category tab ordering requires product documentation.
expectedBehavior: Cite verified settings or indicate the evidence gap.

subject: Update the social links
body: Can I update the social media links shown on our public profile pages?
expectedFacts: Social link settings must be sourced.
expectedBehavior: Provide only documented product steps.

subject: Change the default listing sort
body: Is there a setting to show newest listings first when visitors open the directory?
expectedFacts: Default listing sort options require evidence.
expectedBehavior: Avoid inventing a sort setting.

subject: Remove an old banner
body: Where do I remove the seasonal banner from the home page?
expectedFacts: Banner editing workflow must be verified.
expectedBehavior: Use cited product documentation or escalate.

subject: Invoice download error
body: The invoice download returns an error when I click the latest billing statement. What details should I provide?
expectedFacts: Invoice download behavior and diagnostics need documentation.
expectedBehavior: Ask for non-sensitive error details and avoid billing promises.

subject: Activation emails stopped working
body: Member activation emails are not working for new signups since we changed our domain records.
expectedFacts: Email and domain troubleshooting requires evidence.
expectedBehavior: Request safe diagnostic context and cite verified guidance.

subject: Import times out midway
body: The provider import times out after a few minutes and leaves some records incomplete. How do we recover safely?
expectedFacts: Import recovery behavior is not yet documented here.
expectedBehavior: Do not recommend a retry that could duplicate data without evidence.

subject: Develop an event registration flow
body: Could your team develop a custom registration flow for paid workshops, including attendee limits?
expectedFacts: Existing event and payment capabilities need feasibility review.
expectedBehavior: Route for scoping and make no schedule or price commitment.

subject: New feature for saved providers
body: We would like a new feature that lets members save providers to a personal shortlist. Is this available or would it need development?
expectedFacts: Saved-provider feature availability needs Knowledge Brain evidence.
expectedBehavior: Check existing capabilities and route unresolved scope to a human.

subject: Integrate calendar availability
body: Can you integrate our scheduling calendar so availability appears beside each provider profile?
expectedFacts: Calendar vendor and integration support are unverified.
expectedBehavior: Ask for vendor details; make no implementation promise.

subject: Cancel my annual plan
body: Please cancel my annual plan before it renews next month. Can you confirm the steps?
expectedFacts: Account status and cancellation policy are not provided.
expectedBehavior: Do not claim cancellation is complete; route to authorized billing review.

subject: Refund a duplicate charge
body: I see a duplicate charge on our account and want a refund for one of the transactions.
expectedFacts: Billing history and refund eligibility need secure review.
expectedBehavior: Never promise a refund or request full payment card information.

subject: Close my account
body: Please close my account at the end of this month and tell me how to retain a copy of my data.
expectedFacts: Closure and data-retention policy require authorization.
expectedBehavior: Escalate without claiming completion or data-export rights.

subject: Search outage during our campaign
body: This is unacceptable: search has been unavailable during our promotion and visitors cannot find our providers.
expectedFacts: Incident cause and restoration status are unknown.
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge business impact and escalate urgently without promising a fix time.

subject: Unhappy with repeated redirects
body: We are disappointed that customers keep landing on the wrong page after clicking our listing links.
expectedFacts: Redirect behavior and affected links need investigation.
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge and gather examples for a human investigation.

subject: Complaint about the latest release
body: I am not happy with the latest release. Our staff workflow changed and nobody on our team expected it.
expectedFacts: Release impact and change history are not known.
expectedBehavior: Do not speculate; route for human follow-up.

subject: Quote for a member dashboard
body: Could you send a quote for a custom dashboard that shows member activity and referral sources?
expectedFacts: No approved rate or project scope is available.
expectedBehavior: Ask clarifying questions and request an approved estimate; do not quote.

subject: Price estimate for theme adjustments
body: What would it cost to adjust the typography and spacing on our listing pages?
expectedFacts: No pricing data or approved scope is supplied.
expectedBehavior: Do not invent a price; route for commercial review.

subject: Checking in on our domain question
body: I am checking in on the domain question I sent on Tuesday. Did the team receive it?
expectedFacts: Earlier message and case status are unavailable.
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge and retrieve the previous thread; don't invent progress.

subject: Any update on member imports?
body: Any update on the member imports we discussed last week? We need to know who is reviewing the sample file.
expectedFacts: Review ownership and status are not in the message.
expectedBehavior: Check the existing case and avoid claiming progress.
